paite: Huan Ephraimte akikaikhawm ua, mallam zuan in apai ua; Jephthah kiang ah, "Bangziak a Ammon suante dou dia hong paiphei a, na kiang a hoh dia hon chial sam lou? Na inn toh ka hon buhalkhawm ding uh,” achi uhi.
heading: Jephthah Leh Ephraim Mite

paite: Jephthah in akiang uah, "Ammon suante ka mite toh theihtawp suah in ka dou ua; ka hon sap lai in akhut ua kipan in lah na hon hunkhe ut kei ua.

Huchi in na hon hunkhe nuam kei uh chih ka theihtak in, sih khawk sa lou hial in ka pang a, Ammon suante dou ding in ka kuan a, huchi in TOUPA'N amaute ka khut ah ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in bangziak a hon dou dia tuni a hong kuan na hi ua?" achi hi.

Huchi in Jephthah in Gilead mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Ephraimte adouta hi. Gileadte'n Ephraimte athat uhi. "Nou Gileadte, Ephraimte leh Manassehte lak a galtai vakvai maimaite na hi uh," achih ziak un.

Gileadte'n Ephraimte ma in Jordan lui kainate ana la ua; hichi ahong hi a, Ephraim mi suaktate'n, "Ka hong galkah ding uh," achih chiang un Gileadte'n akiang ah, "Ephraim mi na hi hia?” ana chi zel uh. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” achihleh,

akiang ah, "Shiboleth, chi mah dih," ana chi ua, ama'n, "Siboleth," achi zaw zel a; alouchian thei kei hi. Huchi in aman ua, Jordan lui kainate ah ana that zel uh. Huchi in huai tung in Ephraimte singli-le-sangnih athat uhi.
Jephthah in Israelte tung ah kum guk vai ahawm a, huchi in asita a, Gilead gam a khua khat ah avui uhi.
Anung in Bethlehem a mi Ibzan in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: Ibzan, Elon Leh Abdon

paite: Ama'n tapa sawmthum leh tanu sawmthum anei hi. Atanute gamdang ah asawl a, atapate a ding in gamdang a pan tanu sawmthum apisak hi. Ama'n Israelte tung ah kum sagih vai ahawm hi.
Ibzan asita a, Bethlehem ah avui uh.
Anung in Zebulun mi Elon in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm a; Israelte tung ah kum sawm vai ahawm hi.
Zebulun mi Elon asita a, Zebulun gam a Aijalon ah avui uhi.
Huai nung in Pirathon mi, Hilel tapa Abdon in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Ama'n tapa sawmli leh sabiltungnou sawmsagih tung a tuang zel tupa sawmthum anei hi. Ama'n Israelte tung ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
Pirathon mi, Hilel tapa Abdon asita a, Ephraim gam, Amalek mite tanggam ah Pirathon ah avuita uh.
